Sabse bada sahas wahi hai jab duniya tumhe koi aur banne ko kehti hai, tum khud ki tarah rehna.
Asli himmat darr ko jaan-na hai.
Grit ka matlab hai mushkil samay mein bhi raaste par tikna.
Grit lohe jaisi ichha hai.
Jeet tak persist karo.
Grit sacrifice maangta.
Khamoshi samajh ka jawaab hai.
Himmat tab shuru hoti hai jab tum aate ho.
Kabhi kabhi khamoshi sabse loud hoti hai.
Lakshya ke liye stamina grit hai.
Khamoshi zindagi hai.
Ek shant man ek sahasi vichar ka upjaau zameen hai.
Grit mushkil cheezein lagatar karna.
Quiet mind strong hote.
Grit long game hai.
Grit pain ko purpose banata.
Himmat woh spark jo tufan me bache.
Jab chhodna ho, tab bhi chalte raho.
Jab alfaaz na kaam karein, khamoshi bolti.
Courage—fear ko ek minute aur pakad ke rakhna.
Jo peechhe, jo aage—sab matter karta.
Grit teevra hai.
